source_title: Bulletin, September 25, 2014, Revised Prima Facie Credit Life and Credit Accident and Sickness Insurance Rates
summary: The bulletin of September 25, 2014 sets credit accident and sickness rates for the three-year period beginning January 1, 2015 by adjustment factors applied to the existing prima facie rates, rounded to the nearest cent: 0.89 (14-day retroactive), 0.95 (14-day nonretroactive), 1.00 (30-day retroactive) and 1.00 (30-day nonretroactive). Headline rates are the 12- and 60-month single premium rates from the published table.
